top_signals.title: Russia, Ukraine Exchange Strikes as US Envoys Head for Kyiv
top_signals.summary: Russia and Ukraine exchanged another wave of overnight strikes as US envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff were set to travel to Kyiv from Moscow following talks with President Vladimir Putin.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
